name: Subaru Deep Field pointing 2 (Hubble)
blurb: A deep field toward a distant galaxy in the Subaru Deep Field, seen by Hubble.
label: sdf02-hubble
story: This pointing lies in the Subaru Deep Field, where Hubble looked toward one of the most distant galaxies then known. It came to read the light of young stars in the early universe.

claims.text: SDF stands for the Subaru Deep Field; program 12329 studies spectroscopically confirmed galaxies at 5.7<z<7 there
SDF02 is a pointing on a high-redshift galaxy
The program targets the highest-redshift galaxies known
The WFC3 images measure the rest-frame ultraviolet light of young stellar populations
The Subaru Deep Field is a Subaru Observatory deep galaxy survey over a blank field
